title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E03 — Mimiki Ke Kai, Ahuwale Ka Papa Leho
A heat wave hits Oahu, contributing to a spike in crime; McGarrett and Danny hunt down a bank thief; Tani and Junior's car is stolen while they're on duty; Kamekona incites a riot by price-gouging his ice.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E04 — A'ohe Kio Pohaku Nalo i Ke Alo Pali
Jerry accompanies Junior as he escorts a fallen soldier home to Oahu; McGarrett and Danny discover a body when they delve into the highly profitable black market for sand.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E05 — A'ohe Mea 'Imi a Ka Maka
On Halloween, Jerry and his friends search his childhood camp for evidence to a murder he witnessed as a boy; McGarrett investigates a little girl who drew pictures depicting the scene of a recent murder before it was discovered.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E06 — Aia I Hi'ikua; I Hi'Ialo
McGarrett crosses the line and is arrested while investigating the death of his former SEAL buddy who died while making an emergency landing on an aircraft carrier; Adam returns to Oahu with devastating news about his marriage.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E07 — Pua a'e La Ka Uwahi O Ka Moe
McGarrett investigates a cold case that his grandfather and the famous Honolulu detective Chang Apana worked on in the 1940s; McGarrett and Danny get ready for the opening of their restaurant.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E08 — Lele Pu Na Manu Like
Grover's parents and brother arrive in Oahu for Thanksgiving; a thief is crushed to death by an empty safe.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E09 — Mai Ka Po Mai Ka 'Oia'i'o
When a renowned urban vigilante is killed after making a citizen's arrest, the team delves into the world of superheroes and comic books to find the killer; Adam gets closer to finding out who killed his sister.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E10 — Pio Ke Kukui, Pō'ele Ka Hale
After fighting off an assassin in his own home, McGarrett and Joe White flee to Montana to prepare for a battle against those exacting revenge for a past SEAL mission.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E11 — Hala I Ke Ala O'i'ole Mai
Still reeling from the murder of one of their own, Steve and Catherine, along with Danny, Junior and some old friends, hunt down the killer; a bag of human bones discovered inside an abandoned storage locker goes missing.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E12 — Ka Hauli O Ka Mea Hewa 'Ole, He Nalowale Koke
McGarrett and the team support Danny and Rachel by determining what happened when Grace gets into a life-threatening car accident; Tani helps Koa when his rehab patient goes missing.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E13 — Ke Iho Mai Nei Ko Luna
Adam, Junior and Tani travel to the bottom of the Pacific Ocean when a murder takes place in a remote underwater lab -- and the killer may still be on board.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E14 — Ikiiki i ka la o Keawalua
While investigating Flippa's friend's murder, McGarrett and Grover uncover a deadly plan by an extremist group on the Island; Grover has an emotional reaction to the case.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E15 — Ho'opio 'ia e ka noho ali'i a ka ua
As a dangerous hurricane hits Oahu, Five-0 is tasked with protecting El Diablo, a captured serial killer who is being hunted by an assassin; Tani's civilian safety check during the storm turns deadly; Rachel and Charlie evacuate to Danny's house.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E16 — Hapai ke kuko, hanau ka hewa
When the top salesperson for a beauty company pyramid scheme is murdered, the team sifts through a long list of possible suspects who would want her dead; Adam befriends a homeless man.

title: MacGyver
description:
S02 E17 — Bear Trap + Mob Boss
Mac, Jack and Riley set out to find a mobster-turned-informant after he's kidnapped and taken to Chernobyl by an international crime boss; Bozer struggles to keep a secret from Matty.

title: MacGyver
description:
S02 E18 — Riley + Airplane
Mac and the team reunite with the Coltons, a family of bounty hunters, as they all search for a thief of classified intelligence.

title: MacGyver
description:
S02 E19 — Benjamin Franklin + Grey Duffle
As Mac and the team investigate the suspicious death of Dawn's CIA supervisor, the evidence leads to a dirty CIA agent and a massive counterfeiting ring.

title: MacGyver
description:
S02 E20 — Skyscraper - Power
Mac and Jack attempt to rescue a billionaire's son after he is kidnapped by a former Navy SEAL.

title: MacGyver
description:
S02 E21 — Wind + Water
While helping a friend in Puerto Rico, MacGyver is taken hostage by robbers who are attempting to steal $2 million from the bank his friend manages.

title: MacGyver
description:
S02 E22 — UFO + Area 51
Mac and Riley are called in to examine a mysterious object that crash-landed in the Nevada desert; Riley uncovers new information about Mac's father but questions whether to deliver it to him after he says he needs to move on.

title: MacGyver
description:
S02 E23 — MacGyver + MacGyver
MacGyver gets a shocking surprise when he tries to tell Matty he's quitting the Phoenix Foundation.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E01 — Improvise
Three months after quitting the Phoenix Foundation and moving to Nigeria, Mac puts aside his differences with his father and returns when he hears Jack is the target of a murderous dictator he double-crossed.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S07 E06 — Epilogue
The team investigates when multiple bodies are found in a national forest; Rossi faces an agonizing decision.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S07 E07 — There's No Place Like Home
The BAU investigates when bodies are exposed by tornadoes in Kansas; pressure at work affects J.J. at home.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S07 E08 — Hope
A woman in Garcia's survivors' support group goes missing on the seventh anniversary of her daughter's disappearance.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S07 E09 — Self-Fulfilling Prophecy
The team investigates when an apparent mass suicide takes place at a military academy; Morgan and Hotch clash.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S07 E10 — The Bittersweet Science
The investigation of a series of bludgeoning attacks in Philadelphia leads the team to the city's boxing scene; Hotch connects with a fellow runner while training for the triathlon.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S07 E11 — True Genius
A series of murders makes the team wonder if a notorious killer has returned; Reid wonders if he could be doing more with his abilities.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S07 E12 — Unknown Subject
A serial rapist resurfaces in Houston and assaults his past victims; Prentiss attempts to overcome last year's trauma.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S07 E13 — Snake Eyes
The team investigates ritualistic casino-related murders in New Jersey; a fight with her boyfriend makes Garcia think she and Morgan have gotten too close.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S07 E14 — Closing Time
The team discovers multiple bodies hidden in lifeguard towers along the coast of Southern California.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S07 E15 — A Thin Line
The team uncovers a sinister motive for a string of brutal home invasions.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S07 E16 — A Family Affair
The BAU goes to Atlanta to investigate a series of murders, which they believe are being committed by more than one unsub.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S07 E17 — I Love You, Tommy Brown
Multiple married couples fostering young children are murdered in Seattle; Garcia worries that Kevin is about to propose.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S07 E18 — Foundation
When a young boy is found in the Arizona desert and another goes missing, the team searches for the kidnapper; Morgan draws on his difficult past to connect with the found child.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S07 E19 — Heathridge Manor
The team investigates a series of gothic, ritualistic murders in Oregon.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S07 E20 — The Company
When Morgan's sister sees a woman who looks like their presumed-dead cousin, the BAU reopens the case of her disappearance.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S07 E21 — Divining Rod
After an infamous serial murderer is executed, women in the same Oklahoma town are attacked by a copycat; Prentiss gets nervous about making a major real estate purchase.

title: The Listener
description:
S03 E10 — Lockdown
Toby and the IIB must find the source of a deadly virus before it kills more people.

title: The Listener
description:
S03 E11 — Captain Nightfall
Violent home invasions are being interrupted by a citizen dressed as a superhero.

title: The Listener
description:
S03 E12 — The Bro Code
Oz puts his life in danger after asking Toby to help an old friend who witnessed a murder.

title: The Listener
description:
S03 E13 — The Shooting
The team must prove Michelle was set up after a suspect is shot.

title: Bull
description:
S06 E10 — Frontotemporal
Bull and Chunk aim to prove that their client, a woman on trial for murder, committed the crime due to a lack of behavioral control caused by a brain tumor; Taylor is suspected by the FBI of committing cybercrimes.

title: Bull
description:
S06 E11 — Family Matters
The team finds itself in a tense and unprecedented situation when Bull faces off against Marissa and her new boss in court, following her departure from the company; Taylor's professional life works against her during her custody battle.

title: Bull
description:
S06 E12 — Caliban
The TAC team gets a rare glimpse into Bull's personal life when his estranged brother of 13 years, Jacob Bull, unexpectedly arrives; a financial investor is accused by the FBI of running a Ponzi scheme with his father.

title: Bull
description:
S06 E13 — The Hard Right
Bull helps his friend mount a diminished capacity defense for a sergeant accused of killing a fellow soldier; a French gallery owner needs legal assistance to stop an auction house from selling a piece of art that should be repatriated.

title: Bull
description:
S06 E14 — Safe Space
Bull helps an agoraphobic client bring a wrongful death suit against the alleged killer of his beloved aunt, but the client's inability to testify in person threatens the trial; Chunk's new relationship hits a snag when his mother visits.

title: Bull
description:
S06 E15 — With These Hands
The surgeon who saved Bull's life after his heart attack is sued for malpractice; Taylor fights the urge to check into the background of Henri Fray, Marissa's new love interest.

title: Bull
description:
S06 E16 — The Diana Affair
Bull and Izzy experience marital discord when Bull has the team lead the defense for his ex-girlfriend; personal conflicts abound for the TAC team when Chunk finds himself defending Diana in court against his boyfriend and prosecutor, Robert.

title: Bull
description:
S06 E17 — Dark Horse
Izzy hires Bull to defend a jockey accused of committing arson against a stable owner who fired him.

title: Bones
description:
S08 E02 — The Partners in the Divorce
A powerful divorce lawyer with a lot of enemies is murdered; the three-month separation between Booth and Brennan starts to take its toll.

title: Bones
description:
S08 E03 — The Gunk in the Garage
After an explosion in a hotel garage, the Jeffersonian team tries to identify victims by investigating remains found at the scene; Sweets works with a temporary partner (Danielle Panabaker) while Booth works on the department's budget.

title: Bones
description:
S08 E04 — The Tiger in the Tale
While investigating the death of an animal expo employee, the team is drawn into the world of animal trafficking; Brennan thinks she would be a good presidential candidate; Sweets and Daisy make a change.

title: Bones
description:
S08 E05 — The Method in the Madness
The team investigates the death of a woman whose body was found in the trash; Booth invites Sweets to stay with him and Brennan until he finds a new place.

title: Bones
description:
S08 E06 — The Patriot in Purgatory
While examining bodies deemed unidentifiable, interns uncover the identity of a man who died in the 9/11 terrorist attacks.

title: Bones
description:
S08 E07 — The Bod in the Pod
A pod containing the remains of a crime-scene cleaner washes onto a beach; Angela and Hodgins learn a secret about Cam.

title: Bones
description:
S08 E08 — The But in the Joke
When a street artist falls into his own adhesive, he also lands on human remains that stay glued to his body; Booth searches a comedy club for suspects.

title: Bones
description:
S08 E09 — The Ghost in the Machine
When a psychic tries to help the spirit of a boy whose death the team is investigating, members of the team start to question their own feelings on life and death.

title: Bones
description:
S08 E10 — The Diamond in the Rough
When the team investigates the death of a dancer who was about to audition for a dance competition show, Booth and Brennan go undercover as contestants.

title: Bones
description:
S08 E11 — The Archaeologist in the Cocoon
The team investigates the death of an archaeologist who had just made an important discovery.

title: Bones
description:
S08 E12 — The Corpse on the Canopy
When Angela and Hodgins wake to find a corpse in their bedroom, they believe Pelant is behind it; against Booth's wishes, Angela and Hodgins start their own investigation.

title: Bones
description:
S08 E13 — The Twist in the Plot
The team investigates when two bodies are found at the same burial plot; Brennan and Booth discuss after-death arrangements; Daisy returns for the first time since the breakup.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E09 — The Bucket Job
The Leverage team's Holiday good deed goes awry when their attempt to give a small-town librarian the spy-thriller adventure of a lifetime is interrupted by a shadowy spy organization.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E10 — The Unwellness Job
The team tries to expose a wellness guru who is selling fake medicines to vulnerable people.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E11 — The Jackal Job
The team picks the brain of a legendary grifter and tries to find the loot from her best con before her abusive guardian does.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S01 E12 — The Golf Job
An old friend visits, sparking a self-doubting Harry to uncover an unlikely client on the links at his exclusive golf club.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E16 — Last Gasp
The BAU meets in secret to investigate a subject who appears to be kidnapping and photographing young women.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E17 — The Capilanos
The BAU is called to Oklahoma to investigate a murderous clown who is terrorizing a town.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E18 — The Dance of Love
The BAU travels to Chicago to investigate a case where red roses are left on victims; Rossi gets an unexpected visit from his ex-wife.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E19 — Ex Parte
The BAU takes charge of a hostage situation at a law firm where Matt Simmons' wife works.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E20 — All You Can Eat
The BAU is called upon when bioterrorism is suspected in a series of mysterious deaths; Garcia visits her stepbrother to take care of a difficult family issue.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E21 — Mixed Signals
The BAU is called to Taos, N.M., when someone targets victims' temporal lobes.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S13 E22 — Believer
The team questions the credibility of a former FBI agent's bizarre account.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E01 — 300
When Reid and Garcia are abducted by a mass murderer, it's up to the rest of the team to find them; the BAU looks to their past to solve why the two heroes have been targeted.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E02 — Starter Home
The team tracks a serial killer when remains of numerous victims are found in the walls of an elderly couple's home; the hunt becomes urgent after the BAU learns the killer's specific ritual of when to strike; Rossi reconnects with his ex-wife.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E03 — Rule 34
Packages with gruesome contents are delivered to six people in the Washington, D.C. area; Simmons and Kristy struggle to connect with their son, David, who is suspended from school for aggressive behavior.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E04 — Innocence
Soon after the BAU steps in to help local law enforcement isolate a suspect for a murder, a second person who is related to the first victim is killed under similar circumstances; Prentiss is concerned about Garcia's behavior.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E05 — The Tall Man
The BAU investigates a spooky local ghost story of the "Tall Man" and the clues it provides when two people go missing in the woods; a third person mysteriously surfaces the following day with limited details as to what happened to her friends.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E06 — Luke
The BAU investigates four murders along the eastern seaboard; the crimes become personal for Alvez when the team discovers there are ties to his time spent in pursuit of a notorious hit man; Alvez and his girlfriend decide to move in together.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E07 — Twenty Seven
The BAU races to capture the vigilantes behind a series of attacks taking place every 27 minutes in the nation's capital; Prentiss and Unit Chief Andrew Mendoza lead the effort to identify the vigilantes and what's motivating them.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E08 — Ashley
The BAU investigates a double homicide and kidnapping in New Hampshire; Rossi's plans to elevate his relationship with Krystall don't go as planned.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E09 — Broken Wing
A professor from Lewis' past tips off the BAU to an alarming number of overdose deaths of patients who just completed rehab.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E10 — Flesh and Blood
Prentiss faces her past when the BAU is sent to investigate the murders of prominent businessmen, all of whom are missing their hearts; Prentiss plans a romantic first date with Mendoza, but the evening is cut short by an urgent call from Rossi.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E11 — Night Lights
The BAU team heads to Portland, Ore., to investigate a chilling abduction that may be linked to a local couple who were killed in their home a week earlier.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S14 E12 — Hamelin
The BAU team flies to Iowa to investigate the disappearance of three 10-year-old children who appear to have been abducted from their homes, with surveillance video from a park as their only lead to finding the children's whereabouts.
